Dear Mary,

Do you remember what Professor Sakurai said in class about Eqs. (1.139) and (1.140) in Modern Quantum Mechanics? I'm stuck on today's homework.

  sum_b' <c'|b'><b'|a'><a'|b'><b'|c'>  =  sum_b' sum_b'' <c'|b'><b'|a'><a'|b''><b''|c'>

Let I be the 2x2 identity matrix, X = [[0,1],[1,0]], Z = [[1,0],[0,-1]], D = I+2Z, E = 3I-Z, R = I+2X, S = 3I-X.

No. 62345178 - (Z,X,D)
No. 12345768 - (Z,D,X)
No. 12745638 - (X,D,E)
No. 12354678 - (R,E,S)
No. 42315678 - (Z,D,E)

No. 21345678 - (E,Z,R)
No. 12845673 - (E,R,Z)

Please try them from top to bottom.

By the way, thank you for lending me that novel. I liked it very much. I found this note tucked inside it:

Yours,
Johnny
